title: Musical Voice Leading Analysis of Attention Head Coordination

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: The music theory analogy is creative but the safety connection is very weak. Whether attention heads follow 'voice leading' rules does not directly inform safety. The analogy may impose structure that does not naturally exist.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires extracting per-head attention patterns and defining consonance/dissonance metrics. TransformerLens makes extraction easy. Defining meaningful metrics from music theory requires cross-domain knowledge. Moderate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Extracting attention patterns and computing coordination metrics is bounded. But operationalizing music theory concepts for attention heads requires conceptual work. Feasible in 30 hours as an exploratory study.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
